description: This file defines a Fragment named LogFragment used for displaying logs within an Android application. It contains code to create and configure a LogView inside a ScrollView, handling layout, styling, and preserving scroll position when log data changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages a custom LogView to output log data received via LogNode interface. It handles view creation, layout configuration, and scroll behavior for displaying logs.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding. Returns the root View containing the log.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the views, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the root View.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the LogView instance managed by the fragment.
